author: roxshox
body:
Hi, I'm a casual player on the server and i have enjoyed your nebula games for a long time. The other day, I was playing on the server with a friend and I was banned for abusive language or something of the sort. However I said nothing abusive in the chat whatsoever. It might well have been a mistake by the mod who banned me or maybe he just isn't a trustworthy mod. Either way if you could consider un-banning me I would be rather grateful. It's just slightly dissapointing that's all.
Thanks, Roxshox

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
Hi roxshox
As you can see from these logs: http://imgur.com/MrbQUOe , http://imgur.com/4wbHKfk
You were clearly using inappropriate and offensive language that we do not tolerate.
Even after you were warned you continued and the mod banning you decided a 2 week punishment was valid ;
Since what you said classes under 'suicide encouragement' 

Appeal denied

I'll leave open in case the banning mod or you wishes to reply.
Will lock in 24 hours if not otherwise.

replies.author: roxshox
replies.body: Yes ok I used offensive language. However the chat in game is far to overcrowded and I did not see any warnings. Also I did not "encourage" suicide. Unless you're suggesting a three digit arrangement of letters that don't even form a word encourage suicide. I'll accept the ban but I do think you need to reconsider the way your mods distribute warnings and also the way in which you determine your policies such as "encouraging suicide". Also, if you have such as issue with inappropriate language, perhaps make the rules on it more clear or even install a plugin which filters swearing from text.

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
First of ./warn was implemented so players did not miss it. It's your responsibility and regarding what you said and it should of been common sense what you were saying is wrong.

You can see here how obvious it is here:http://imgur.com/JGyviAT

Also , yes i am suggesting the 3 letters forming the abbreviation 'kys' is encouraging suicide it is the universal term for 'kill your self' and i'm sure your aware of this. People take things like this very seriously i'm sure you've heard lot's of cases of it online ; Therefore so do we. 

Furthermore you continue to say "people who say lmao deserve to die" i think it's quite obvious what context you were using it in. As seen here: http://imgur.com/4wbHKfk
 
Our policies in this subject are perfectly acceptable and reasonable , in the example of 'suicide encouragement' we have such 'harsh' guidelines for it because , as i said above , it's such a serious and sensitive topic.

You say our rules are are unclear on the subject but to start of i think it should be very obvious 'suicide encouragement' is not allowed and it also falls under many of our rules , such as: A1 , A3 and A9 

Moving on to your final suggestion about making a filter we allow swearing as long as it's not directed or excessive so there really is no need for a filter.

Thanks for showing concern on how we hand out punishments , but it is perfectly valid and reasonable in this department.
